names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 9528, «Владимир (Вятский), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off.

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints after his name: «Сщмч. Владимира пресвитера (1939)».

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 26 сентября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Владимира пресвитера (1939).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's own 26 septembrie was not read (2026-10-04); the Romanian calendar does not generally keep the Russian new martyrs.
